title: Nourishing Crispy Russian Orzo Pilaf
description: A citrusy and crispy Russian dish featuring cinnamon stick, with an al-dente finish, perfect for crowds and egg-free friendly, this orzo pilaf is a must try. It combines the warmth of cinnamon with the brightness of citrus
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the orzo and cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the chicken broth, salt, and black pepper, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes or until the liquid is absorbed.
Stir in the lemon juice and add the cinnamon stick.
Cook for an additional 2 minutes or until the orzo is crispy and golden brown.
Remove the cinnamon stick and serve hot.
